free_tier.stated: 200 free minutes over 14 days, up to 8 jobs at once, Linux only, with no card; a card is needed only when the minutes run out. Beyond the trial the Basic plan is USD 0.001 a core-minute, so a 2-core runner is USD 0.002 a minute and an 8-core runner USD 0.008.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: a job is bounded by the runner size, chosen with a label such as compiler-8cpu

retention.stated: not applicable: a job runs and is destroyed; the trial itself ends after 14 days

egress.terms: not stated: the page prices compute per core-minute and publishes no egress allowance or egress charge

tooling: a GitHub App installation and a runs-on label change on an existing workflow; no agent or self-hosted runner is needed
chaining: GitHub Actions on a public repository stays free and comes first; compiler.dev sells private-repository minutes at USD 0.001 a core-minute, which is USD 0.002 for 2 cores against GitHub list price of USD 0.006, and the 200 free minutes are enough to compare one pipeline before a card is added
